name: Yunyu
description: A star 42 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114971: radius 11.028 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 62.783 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.052) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114971: effective temperature 4896 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.04)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 2.44 from 2024A&A...682A.145S; the 33 published values span log g 2.25 to 3.04, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114971: distance 42.301 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.008), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 42 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 63 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,896 K, so 11.028 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 114971: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Gamma Piscium
quotes.card: Gamma Piscium, also named Yunyu, is a star approximately 135 light-years away from Earth in the equatorial-northern zodiac constellation of Pisces.
quotes.introduction: It is a yellow star with a spectral type of G8 III, meaning it has a surface temperature of 4,833 K and is a giant star.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2658974606111711488 (quality A), from 2018A&A...615A..31D; Gaia DR3 measures none
